name: Baratza Sette 270
details: Electric conical grinder with macro settings and a stepless-feel micro adjustment; espresso-focused.

grindRanges.scale: macro settings 1–31 (the micro adjustment fine-tunes between them)

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 1–7, moka pot 7–18, AeroPress 5–31, V60 9–20, filter coffee machine 4–28, French press 21–31, cold brew 25–31; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
